event_meeting.note: an attendee the team reaches after an event books a meeting

meeting_from_positive.note: a positive reply becomes a held meeting

no_show.note: a booked meeting does not happen

opportunity_from_meeting.note: an AE opens an opportunity after a held meeting

positive_reply.note: the share of replies that are positive

reply.note: a person replies to one outbound email, any reply

unsubscribe.note: a person opts out on one outbound email

win.note: an opportunity's outcome uses Market Desk's win model (market_model.py: BASE_BY_BAND, PRICE_MULT, INDUSTRY_MULT, SOURCE_MULT), so wins in the rehearsal follow the planted relationships
